text:
maria: Hey team — incoming SIG from HelixData, they attached a filled CAIQ spreadsheet and want answers plus evidence. Customer asked for response by EOD Friday. Anyone available to own security intake and coordinate POC pricing?

kevin: I can cover POC scoping / pricing. For a short dedicated-capacity POC we usually quote: 2 engineers for 2 weeks + $6k infra credit. Happy to validate if they want embedded flow.

sanjay: I can own the SIG review and evidence collection. Two quick asks: 1) Do they require PCI or just SOC2/ISO baseline? 2) Need list of infra accounts (GCP project IDs) and any compliance docs they already have.

maria: Thanks both. Customer asked for PCI only if we touch card data — Helix says POC will not process cards but may simulate tokens. I'll confirm but assume non-PCI for now. Their security contact is emma@helixdata.com.

kevin: For the POC we should propose an architecture doc + a minimal test plan. I'll draft pricing and a template test plan tonight and link it here.

sec-bot: Checklist created: SIG intake assigned -> sanjay; evidence bucket -> requested; POC pricing draft -> assigned to kevin. Link: https://redwood.internal/checks/1722223344

sanjay: Quick technical clarifier for Helix: please provide the following in reply: - list of data in scope - are they hosting in our Dedicated environment or using Hosted API - any required SSO/SCIM integrations. Also need screenshots for `encryption at rest` and KMS key ARN if available.

maria: @emma (copied to email) — can you confirm environment (hosted vs dedicated) and share any existing compliance pack? Deadline Friday EOD.

ops: Noted the deadline. If Helix confirms dedicated, we might need a short quote for Reserved capacity; kevin will include that option.

kevin: Draft pricing paper: will include two variants (hosted - per token estimate; dedicated - reserved monthly + infra). Will post in #sales-papers once ready.

sanjay: I'll start reviewing CAIQ answers and request system logs + config screenshots. If they push for PCI, we escalate to compliance and will need a timeline extension.

maria: Assigning owner in our tracker: security_owner=sanjay, poc_owner=kevin. I'll update the ticket and ping emma for the missing artifacts. Thanks all :thumbsup:
